entities.summary: Travis George Buck is an American baseball coach and former professional outfielder, who is currently an assistant for the University of Oregon. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Oakland Athletics, Cleveland Indians and Houston Astros, and was an assistant coach for Loyola Marymount University.
